LESSON: HEALING OF OF JESUS CHRIST

Grade: Grade 1
Subject: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: The 3.4 Wedding By the end of the Sub strand, the ● Learners to read John 2:1-10
Topic 3.5: Healing of of Jesus Christ

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello learner! Today we will learn about Healing of of Jesus Christ. Read carefully, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. appreciate Simon Peter’s mother-in-law’s reaction by expressing gratitude for every good gift they receive express gratitude to God

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. appreciate Simon Peter’s mother-in-law’s reaction by expressing gratitude for every good gift they receive express gratitude to God
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to appreciate Simon Peter’s mother-in-law’s reaction by expressing gratitude for every good gift they receive express gratitude to God. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: At home, obey your parent when they ask you to wash your plate. That shows obedience.

Example 2: Tell the truth if you break a cup. Saying what really happened is honesty.

Example 3: Thank God for your family before you sleep. A short prayer can be: “Thank you God for today.”

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Read the examples above again. Underline two new words or ideas about Healing of of Jesus Christ.
2. Explain Healing of of Jesus Christ to a parent or classmate using your own words and one Kenyan example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Healing of of Jesus Christ.
4. Show that you can: appreciate Simon Peter’s mother-in-law’s reaction by expressing gratitude for every good gift they receive express gratitude to God
5. Complete the Work to do section, then attempt the Revision Quiz. Check Answers only after you finish.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Healing of of Jesus Christ. Use examples from your school, home, or market.
2. Answer this question in your exercise book: Why is Healing of of Jesus Christ important to you?
3. Make a short oral presentation (about one minute) to your parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 8: REMEMBER

1. appreciate Simon Peter’s mother-in-law’s reaction by expressing gratitude for every good gift they receive express gratitude to God

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Learner lesson
